verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents its own task system (intentions, stories, tasks), a GitHub connection, an MCP endpoint and a CLI. Nothing in the evidence shows integrations with third-party issue trackers such as Jira, Linear, ClickUp, or Monday.com. Its native task management and GitHub linking are adjacent features and do not connect external trackers.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can connect issue trackers like Jira, Linear, ClickUp, or Monday.com so agents can manage tickets directly
